title: Registration Form
content: Build comprehensive registration form. Fields: full name, email, password, confirm password. Password requirements: minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character - show checklist that updates live. Password strength meter: visual bar (red/yellow/green). Confirm password: validate matches password. Terms checkbox: required, link to terms and privacy policy. Submit button: "Create Account", loading state. Social signup options: OAuth buttons for Google, GitHub.

variants.simple: Create signup form with name, email, password, and confirm password fields.
variants.detailed: Build comprehensive registration form. Fields: full name, email, password, confirm password. Password requirements: minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character - show checklist that updates live. Password strength meter: visual bar (red/yellow/green). Confirm password: validate matches password. Terms checkbox: required, link to terms and privacy policy. Submit button: "Create Account", loading state. Social signup options: OAuth buttons for Google, GitHub.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive registration form with strong password requirements and social options. Fields: full name (required, 2-50 chars), email (required, valid format, async check for existing accounts), password (required, with strength meter), confirm password (required, must match). Password requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character (!@#$%^&*) - show live checklist with Check/X icons that update as user types, green when met. Password strength meter: visual bar below input using 4-5 segments, colors from red (Very Weak) through yellow (Weak/Fair) to green (Strong/Very Strong), calculate score based on length + character variety + no common patterns. Confirm password: real-time validation showing match status, error if mismatch on blur. Password visibility: toggle (Eye/EyeOff) for both password fields independently. Terms checkbox: required, label with links to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (open in new tab), must be checked to submit. Marketing opt-in: optional checkbox for newsletter/updates. Submit button: "Create Account" text, primary style, full width, loading state with spinner, disabled until form valid. Social signup: "Or sign up with" divider, Google and GitHub OAuth buttons with brand icons. On submit: POST to API, show loading, handle errors inline. Success: show "Check your email to verify your account" message with illustration. Validation: inline errors on blur, validate all on submit. Form state: disable submit button until all required fields valid. Handle existing email error: suggest login instead. Accessibility: proper labels, aria-describedby for requirements, announce errors.
